decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable, portable Bluetooth speaker for travel. The Bang & Olufsen (prod_bluetooth_speakers_195) is very high-quality but expensive for my current budget. The DOSS SoundBox Pro+ (prod_bluetooth_speakers_008) is highly rated but several reviews mentioned it is heavier and larger than expected for a 'portable' speaker. The HyperGear (prod_bluetooth_speakers_072) had reports of weaker bass, and the XENEO (prod_bluetooth_speakers_150) has a difficult-to-use FM interface. Furthermore, the search results were cluttered with many non-speaker items like cases and power adapters, and higher-end smart speakers like Sonos and Audio Pro had concerning reports of DOA units and setup issues. Consequently, I have decided not to make a purchase today.
